rightsReview.reason: Full municipal site policy reviewed; it reserves information/images against unauthorized reproduction with statutory exceptions. Retain only minimum independently structured ordered calls and public interchange relations from two actual June 1 2025 Nerima-line columns, with URL/date/hash and separately licensed P11 identities. No clocks, fares, full tables, map artwork or prose retained. This is independently published municipal service evidence, not a copy acquired from the contractor website with its separate restrictive terms. Current municipal page identifies the route provider and Kokusai Kogyo contractor and explicitly connects Tobu-nerima and Hikawadai rail stations. General passenger service; retain provider/contractor roles separately. Current-linked diagram reviewed; the Kitamachi loop has direction-specific calls and is not reversed automatically.
